shortDescription: Stacks up to 7 playable z-levels (3 up / 3 down) into ONE banded RimWorld Map joined by synthetic RegionLink wormholes, so hauling, needs, work and storage come free from vanilla. Three uniformly-efficient per-level sizes (126/190/254) bought from a 146,000-cell budget. Wall-mounted junction and breaker boxes bridge power and pipe networks between levels across six supported utility mods. Per-colony climate bands make high levels genuinely alpine. LIVE IN OPEN BETA as Workshop item 3776015553.
body:
> **NOTE TO SELF:** running spec, not a changelog. §0 handover; §1-19 architecture; §20 compat; §21-29 bug records; §30 utility networks; §31 publishing; §32 pathing cost; §33 cross-level drafted movement. Keep every ⚠ - each cost a run to learn.

# As above, So below II (V2)

> V1 is DELETED. ~81 files, ~25,200 LOC. No em-dashes anywhere in shipped text.

# 0. START HERE

**What this mod is.** Up to seven z-levels in ONE RimWorld `Map`, banded along +z. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from above, (2) performance, (3) vanilla parity.

**CURRENT PHASE: SHIPPED, OPEN BETA, BACK IN BUILD MODE.** Published 2026-08-01 as **Workshop item 3776015553** (public). Folder fully restored and `build_mod` green. See §31.

**⚠ THE VERIFICATION TABLE BELOW WAS RE-BASED 2026-08-01.** The user tested the 190 and 254 tiers, all 15 utility networks, the elevator and the multi-hop stair router **outside Modmixer, without the agent present**. The test-run log in §9 records agent-driven runs ONLY and is an INCOMPLETE record of what has been exercised.

**The standing risk (unchanged).** §29's depth cut ships ON, judged by eye only. **Any performance report on a mountainous map: throw `MassDepthCutEnabled` first.**

**How to test §30.** `run_test_cycle` with all six `companionMods` or 28 of 30 defs stay behind their LoadFolders gate. **Run the riser report BEFORE theorising.**

---

## Status
Visuality, QOL, altitude/weather, settings VERIFIED.
**✅ §24b ✅ §24c ✅ §27 ✅ §28 ✅ §29 accepted on look (#260).**
**✅ §2 NEW LADDER generates clean.** All three tiers exercised.
**✅ §30 ALL 15 NETWORKS LINK AND ARE EXERCISED.**
**✅ §32b DOOR/PAWN BAND SCOPE VERIFIED IN PLAY (#294)** - 50.0% of door writes and 14.3% of pawn checks skipped, on a 5-band map.
**🔧 §8b DEPTH SHRINK NARROWED TO LOOSE CONTENTS - BUILT, UNVERIFIED IN PLAY.**
**🔧 §25 FIXED, UNVERIFIED** - needs the reporter's save.
**🔧 §30a power gutter clamp BUILT, UNVERIFIED.**
**🔧 §32a CROSS-BAND REJECTION LIVE BUT NEVER FIRED** - 433 requests inspected, 0 rejected, no raid run yet.
**🔧 §32c HEURISTIC SLIDER SHIPS AT 1.00 (OFF) AND IS UNEXERCISED CODE.**
**🔧 §33 ALL THREE CROSS-LEVEL MOVEMENT FIXES BUILT, NONE SEEN IN PLAY.**
**🎨 ART: only the power junction has real art (3 files). 87 of 90 riser textures are generated placeholders. DISCLOSED at the top of the Workshop description. THE HEADLINE BETA GAP.**
**⚠ CROSS-LEVEL COMBAT IS PARTIAL** - down works, up does not render. DISCLOSED. **Same downward-only asymmetry as §33b; see that entry for the shape.**

---

# 1. ARCHITECTURE
One `Map`, size `(w, 1, bandCount * Slot)`. `Slot = ceil((bandHeight + 2) / 64) * 64`; **64-alignment of SLOT is load-bearing**.

**The one insight.** `Region.Neighbors` is *topological, not spatial*. Wormhole `RegionLink`s between one-cell `RegionType.Portal` ends conduct connectivity without merging rooms, temperature or vacuum. Reachability is not a path: 1.6's pathfinder is jobified and cannot traverse a synthetic link, hence segmented movement (§3).

**⚠ THE TOPOLOGICAL TRICK DOES NOT GENERALISE TO UTILITY NETWORKS.** `RegionLink` is read by the region graph and NOTHING else. Every power/pipe system builds its graph from raw CELL ADJACENCY (§30).

**⚠ THE GUTTER IS UNBUILDABLE BY CONSTRUCTION.** `AB_OpenAir` declares **no affordances**.

**⚠ THE GUTTER IS ALSO UNPATHABLE BY CONSTRUCTION, INCLUDING FOR FLYING PAWNS.** `AB_OpenAir` is `Impassable` and does NOT set `forcePassableByFlyingPawns`, the only exemption `PathGrid.CalculatedCostAt` honours for `PathGridDef Flying`. A band is a sealed pocket for every traversal mode. §32 depends on this; if that field is ever added, §32's guard needs a flying exemption.

**⚠ AND THE MOD IS DOWNWARD-ONLY IN THREE PLACES, WHICH IS ONE DESIGN DECISION WEARING THREE COSTUMES.** `TryResolveVisibleBelow` descends; the see-through click rule only subtracts (`clickPos.z - drop`); the combat renderer only draws down. Every "X does not work upward" report traces back to this. §33b fixed the click case by adding the VIEW BAND as a second input; the combat case (§13 item 2) is still open and is the same shape.

**Hard 1.6 constraints.** No `PathFinder.FindPath`. **⚠ The stack is 2x to 7x anisotropic.** For pathfinder cost see **§32**.

### ⚠ THE SLICING RULE, nine shapes
| Shape | Example | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| Anchor, a fraction of `Size.z` | river/lake centre; VEE Crater jitter | remap the point |
| Field, a gradient on map centre | coastline; VEE LoneIsland | re-centre the sample |
| Noise space, a slice is not a short map | Map Preview (§6d); GL grids (§22); Rimefeller oil (§30e) | generate full height, then crop |
| Distance-to-extent | `CloseToEdge`, no-build edge; river WIDTH | re-base onto the band rect |
| Aspect ratio, normalised by BOTH dims | preview + reroll grid (§6d) | lay out from the BAND, generate at the STACK |
| Map-wide scalar | snow melt, temperature readout, GL roof sweep | rewrite per cell at the consumer |
| Foreign absolute writes (§22) | GL landform output lands in band 0 | ORDER, not arithmetic |
| Radius search wider than the gutter (§30a) | `ConnectMaxDist` 6 vs a 3-cell gap | clip the rect to the band |
| **Whole-map list sweep** (§32) | every door / every spawned pawn, per path request | bucket the list per band |

Unaudited: Basin, Cavern, Chasm, Cliffs, Hollow, Valley. **`ABBandLocal.cs` is THE canonical FIELD rewrite** plus `BandLocalModule`.

# 2. LEVEL PLAN — budget 146,000, ladder 7 / 4 / 2

| size | slot | gutter | gap | cost/band | playable | max levels | total |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 126 | 128 | 2 | 3 | 16,128 | 98.4% | 7 (cap) | 112,896 |
| **190** | 192 | 2 | 3 | 36,480 | 99.0% | **4** | 145,920 |
| 254 | 256 | 2 | 3 | 65,024 | 99.2% | 2 | 130,048 |

**⚠ EXACTLY ONE MAXIMALLY EFFICIENT HEIGHT PER 64-STEP.** Efficient heights are `slot - 2`: **62, 126, 190, 254, 318, 382**. Anchoring 190 *determined* 126 and 254.
**⚠ UNIFORM GUTTER IS A TESTING WIN.** Every tier is gutter 2 / gap 3 - the confound §30a walked into is gone.
**⚠ WHAT WAS GIVEN UP.** 250/300 were vanilla Medium/Large exactly. **318 is blocked by arithmetic** (2 x 101,760 = 203,520). **62 is deliberately absent** - `SeamMarginFor` takes 13%. **The wide gutter was real safety and is gone.**
**⚠ THE BUDGET CUT.** 146,000 = 4 x 190, down 24%. **Generation cost tracks BAND size, not total cells.**
**⚠ THE BUDGET'S STATED JUSTIFICATION WAS PARTLY WRONG - THE BUDGET ITSELF IS NOT.** See §32.
**⚠ 200 IS STILL THE ONE NUMBER TO AVOID** - gutter 56, 21.9% wasted. **Waste is a SAWTOOTH.**
**Old saves are safe.** **⚠ THE PLAN PERSISTS BETWEEN COLONIES.** **⚠ Own the widget, do not patch the data.**

# 3-8a. MOVEMENT, MASS, CAMERA
**Cross-band movement** segmented at ONE interception (`Pawn_PathFollower.StartPath`); hops strictly decrease. Multi-hop exercised by the user out of band.
**⚠ ONE DESCENT RULE: `TryResolveVisibleBelow`.** TEN systems share it; NINE appearances of the single-step bug. **`TryResolveVisibleFrom` is THE gate.**
**⚠ THE BELOW VIEW IS MIRRORED PASSES, NOT ONE RENDERER** (§6a). **⚠ THREE THINGS ARE CALLED "MASS".** **⚠ MASS FILL IS EMITTED FROM THREE PLACES.** **⚠ THE CAP IS SINGLE-STEP.** **⚠ VISIBILITY IS `ABBands.ShowsBelow(terrain)`.**
**⚠ EVERY FOREIGN NETWORK SHIPS ITS OWN `SectionLayer` AND NONE ARE MIRRORED** (§30f).
**Water** is TWO-PASS SCREEN-SPACE, **all three patches inert under GL** (§22).
**⚠ PERSPECTIVE MODE WAS BUILT AND REMOVED. Do not re-add as polish.**
Ore `x(1+0.45*(depth-1))`. **⚠ The snow line never worked.** Camera clamp + level-switch share `ABGuard.Camera`.

# 8b. THE DEPTH SHRINK — SCOPE IS LOOSE CONTENTS ONLY
`ABDepthView` is the ONE definition of the depth cue (`ScaleForLevels`, slider 60-100%, default 85%). Two consumers: the printed mesh (`SectionLayer_ABBelowV2`) and the realtime pawn pass (`ABBelowDynamicDraw` -> `Patch_PawnRenderer_ABBelowShrink`).

**⚠ BUILDINGS DO NOT SHRINK. `CanShrink` IS AN ALLOW-LIST ON `ThingDef.category`.** Allowed: **Item**, **Plant**, **Filth**. Everything else, Building first, returns false. **Pawns take the realtime path and DO shrink.**
**⚠ THE REASON IS THAT TERRAIN IS NEVER SHRUNK.** A shrunken building no longer fits its own footprint and reads as *wrong size*, not as distance. HARD rule.
**⚠ THE `linkType` TEST IS KEPT THOUGH THE CATEGORY TEST SUBSUMES IT** - mods ship linked PLANTS and ITEMS.
**⚠ THE PAWN MATRIX NOW CARRIES TWO EFFECTS (§33c) AND THEY MULTIPLY IN ONE POSTFIX.** Do not add a second `[HarmonyPatch]` on `GetDrawParms`.
Keyed `AB_DepthFalloffTip` states the building exemption; keep the two in sync.

# 9. GENERATION COST

## 9a. The profile stamps its own conditions
`TILE`, `PLAN`, `SCOPING:`, two censuses, the bisect state. Has voided or explained EIGHT comparisons. **⚠ THE WATER REPORT DOES NOT AND SHOULD.**

## 9c-9f. Measured cost curve
**⚠ THIS TABLE RECORDS AGENT-DRIVEN RUNS ONLY.**

**OLD LADDER**: #231 7x126 Flat ~5.7 s | #236 3x250 SmallHills ~12.4 s | #237 5x190 Mtn ~6.9 s | #255 5x190 Mtn Boreal **~4.1 s** (best) | #259/#260 5x190 +Caves ~5.3/5.8 s.

**NEW LADDER** (146,000 budget, all 5x126):
| run | tile | gensteps | carve | total |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| #276 | Flat TempForest, rain 1327 | 1,447 | 1,218 | ~2.9 s |
| #277 | LargeHills +Caves +River, rain 2221 | 1,695 | 1,510 | ~3.4 s |
| #278 | Flat ExtremeDesert, rain 158 | 743 | 674 | **~1.6 s** |
| #279 | LargeHills TempForest, rain 762 | 1,627 | 975 | ~2.8 s |
| #294 | **Mountainous ExtremeDesert, rain 139** | 1,090 | 1,998 | ~3.1 s |

**⚠ THE NEW LADDER'S WHOLE RANGE SITS BELOW THE OLD LADDER'S BEST (4.1 s).**
**⚠ FillRock is SUPERLINEAR in band size** and dominates a mountainous tile: #294 spent **1,575 ms of a 1,998 ms carve in `FillRock band 0` alone**.
**⚠ RAINFALL DOMINATES `GenStep_Plants`:** 25.3 ms at rain 158 vs 543 ms at rain 1327 - a **21x spread**.
**⚠ THE `Caves` CLAIM IS DEMOTED TO A RANGE.** n=2 was not a pattern, again.
**⚠ HILLINESS DECIDES WHETHER A RENDERING TEST IS VALID AT ALL.**
**⚠ `Pathing.RecalculateAllPerceivedPathCosts` RUNS AT EVERY `Map.FinalizeInit`, ONCE PER `PathGridDef` WITH A WORKER (Normal, FenceBlocked, Flying)** - 3 x NumGridCells managed `CalculatedCostAt` calls on generation AND save load. Measured inside #294's 73.7 ms `Map.FinalizeInit`. Air cells are already free there.

## 9g. ⚠ RE-RANKED ON EVIDENCE
1. **Basement rock suppression** - ~1.0-4.3 s, tile-independent. **Item 1.**
2. `GenStep_Plants` scoping - rainfall-driven. **Demoted.**
3. `GenStep_RockChunks`. 4. Scattered ruins. 5. Perlin precompute.

# 10-12. PERF AND DIAGNOSTICS
59.6 fps at 96 pawns. **⚠ THAT MEASURES THE WRONG THING** - cost is in section-regeneration BURSTS.
**⚠ BISECT TOGGLES PERSIST ACROSS RUNS, AND THE STAMP IS WHY WE CATCH IT.**
**⚠ The pre-pinned palette always strips its LAST entry. n=19.** Pad with a DISTINCT throwaway.
**⚠ OUR PROFILE / BISECT / RISER / PATHING lines arrive as `warning` ROWS ATTRIBUTED TO US** - a run reporting only those is CLEAN. **Info level is filtered out of the bridge.**
**⚠ AN ERROR HASH IS A STACK SIGNATURE, NOT A FILE.**
**⚠ INSTRUMENT BEFORE THE THIRD GUESS.**
**⚠ TWO COUNTERS IN DIFFERENT PATCHES THAT SHOULD TRACK 1:1 ARE A FREE CROSS-CHECK.** #294 read `guardCalls=433` against `filterCalls=432` from two unrelated patches on the same request stream. Landing one apart proved both saw the same traffic - a stronger result than either number alone. **Design counter pairs this way on purpose.**

# 13. OPEN WORK
1. **ART.** 87 of 90 riser textures are placeholders - headline beta gap, now a public promise. Regenerate the power junction too.
2. **CROSS-LEVEL COMBAT: upward shooting does not render.** The other disclosed gap. **See §1's downward-only note - §33b is the worked example of the fix shape.**
3. **VERIFY §33** - three fixes built, none seen in play. Draft a pawn, order it UP.
4. **VERIFY §8b**, **§30a**, **§25**.
5. **VERIFY §32a with a raid** - sappers/manhunters are the `FindPathNow` callers most likely to cross bands. Never fired in #294.
6. **§32c heuristic slider is unexercised code.** Ships at 1.00 (inert).
7. **Basement rock suppression** (§9g item 1).
8. **§30 polish:** `PipeGrid[P, cell]` not rewritten on merge; DBH overlay may colour two merged levels separately. Cosmetic.
9. §18 audit; VEE compat; GL roof fix; reroll grid; camera anchor; preview at 254.
10. **Never exercised:** basement PATHING, cavern basement.
11. **§22 TABLED.** 12. **CAI 5000** (§26). 13. **§30g** VTE vs `ABSkySync`. 14. **§30e Rimefeller oil.**
15. **Delete the orphaned private Workshop item 3773267907** (§31).
16. **§32f:** band-slice the `providerCost`/`blocked` clears; reduce request COUNT.

# 14. LESSONS
**Method.** Prove a subsystem innocent by finding a state where the suspect CANNOT EXIST. Change one thing per experiment. **Run the diagnostic before the third theory** - and when there is none, BUILD ONE. A beautiful fit is not evidence.
**⚠ THE AGENT'S TEST LOG IS NOT THE PROJECT'S TEST HISTORY.** **Before writing an untested claim into player-facing copy, ASK.**
**⚠ A GUARD CLAUSE THAT SILENTLY EARLY-RETURNS IS INDISTINGUISHABLE FROM AN UNIMPLEMENTED FEATURE** (§30c, §32).
**⚠ ASSERTING AN INVARIANT IS NOT ESTABLISHING IT.**
**⚠ A PERFORMANCE CLAIM COPIED INTO THREE FILES IS STILL ONE UNVERIFIED CLAIM** (§32). **Duplication made it look corroborated. Read the consumer before quoting the cost.**
**⚠ A BURST-COMPILED METHOD CANNOT BE HARMONY PATCHED, AND FAILS SILENTLY.** `[BurstCompile]` swaps the job system's dispatch pointer for native code. `PathGridJob` and `PathFinderJob` are both Burst structs. **Check for the attribute before planning a patch on anything in a `Job` type.** Corollary: a job holding MANAGED references can never be Burst, so it IS patchable - that is why `PathGridDoorsBlockedJob` was reachable.
**⚠ THE CHEAPEST OPTIMISATION IS DELETING WORK THAT CANNOT MATTER, NOT MAKING WORK CHEAPER.**
**⚠ AN OVERLAY MUST AGREE WITH WHERE THE RENDERER PUTS THE THING, NOT WITH WHERE THE THING IS** (§33a). `LocalizeForPawn` localized onto the PAWN'S band and was correct in every case anyone tested, because view band and pawn band are identical whenever you are looking at that pawn's level. It was wrong the instant you looked DOWN at a pawn, because the below pass draws at `DrawPos.z + drop`. **Ask which subsystem is the authority on the coordinate before choosing a frame of reference.**
**⚠ THREE COPIES OF ONE TRANSFORM, TWO OF THEM RIGHT.** The band-lift existed as `LocalizeForPawn`, as a private `Lift` in the goto patch, and inline in `ABBelowDynamicDraw`. The majority being correct is exactly why the odd one out survived. **Duplication is how an invariant dies - and a copy that is right is not evidence the others are.**
**⚠ A SYMPTOM CAN BE TWO DEFECTS WITH OPPOSITE FIXES** (§33a). "The path line stops at the stairs" was one line missing (never computed) and one line misplaced (drawn a Slot off screen). Either fix alone leaves the report standing and looks like a failed fix. **Count the defects before writing the patch.**
**⚠ A VISUAL EFFECT IS ONLY CORRECT RELATIVE TO WHAT IT IS *NOT* APPLIED TO** (§8b). **Ask what stays fixed before deciding what may move.**
**⚠ WHEN A FEATURE NEEDS A TIME WINDOW, ASK WHETHER THE WINDOW CAN BE READ FROM GEOMETRY INSTEAD** (§33c). The stair animation wanted to hold the pawn while it shrank; driving the shrink off DISTANCE TO THE ANCHOR instead made it stateless, self-cancelling and incapable of stranding anyone. **A timer you have to clean up is a bug you have to find.**
**⚠ HALF-IMPOSED ORDERING IS WORSE THAN NONE.** **⚠ COUNT THE EMITTERS BEFORE FIXING THE LOOK.** **⚠ CLEAR THE OTHER SUSPECT BY READING ITS DATA, NOT ITS CODE.** **⚠ A FIX FOR MOD X CAN BE A REGRESSION FOR EVERYONE WITHOUT X.** **⚠ REPRODUCING A SUBSYSTEM MEANS REPRODUCING ALL OF IT.** **⚠ REUSING A PREDICATE IS REUSING ITS HIDDEN CONDITIONS.** **⚠ TWO RESOLVERS FOR ONE QUANTITY IS A BUG WITH A DELAY FUSE.** **⚠ ASK HOW THE SUBSYSTEM REPRESENTS THE THING, NOT WHAT THE THING IS.**
**⚠ CHECK THAT YOUR CONFIGURATION CAN EXPRESS THE DIFFERENCE** - and **the TIER is part of that configuration**.
**⚠ A QUANTISED PARAMETER HAS FEWER LEGAL VALUES THAN IT LOOKS.**
**⚠ A BUDGET SET BY THE HEAVIEST OPTION IS PAID BY EVERY USER.**
**⚠ A COST MODEL CAN GOVERN THE WRONG AXIS AND STILL LOOK CORRECT.**
**⚠ IF THE CHEAPEST OPTION LOOKS LIKE THE MOST EXPENSIVE, THE UI IS LYING.**
**⚠ n=2 IS NOT A PATTERN, AND NEITHER IS n=4.**
**⚠ N MODS CAN BE FEWER THAN N PROBLEMS - COUNT THE CODEBASES.**
**⚠ A FOREIGN MOD'S OWN DEFS CAN BE WRONG - DO NOT COPY THEM BLIND.**
**⚠ A DEPENDENCY LIST NAMES THE REAL PATCH TARGET.** **⚠ GATE AGAINST THE HOST MOD'S OWN UNLOCK.** **⚠ A MOD CAN HAVE A RESEARCH SYSTEM THAT IS NOT `ResearchProjectDef`.** **⚠ AN ENUM IS A CAPABILITY LIST, NOT A CONTENT LIST.**
**⚠ TWO CALL SITES OF ONE CONSTANT CAN NEED TWO DIFFERENT FIXES** (§30a).
**⚠ A DECOMPILE SHOWS THE API OF THE VERSION THAT MOD WAS BUILT AGAINST.**
**⚠ A LOSSY NORMALISER IS NOT A WAY TO READ A CHOICE.** **⚠ A RULE ENFORCED BY GREPPING A SYNTAX ONLY CATCHES THAT SYNTAX.** **⚠ A DESIGN CHOICE RECORDED WITHOUT ITS COST WILL BE READ AS FREE.** **⚠ THE REAL CONFLICT IS USUALLY A REPLACEMENT, NOT A COLLISION.** **⚠ CHECK WHETHER IT IS ALREADY BUILT BEFORE BUILDING IT** - §33a's job-line localizer already existed and only needed its frame of reference corrected.
**⚠ Compat work is mostly deletion.** **⚠ Waste is often a sawtooth.** **⚠ A comment is not an invariant.** **⚠ Steady-state fps hides burst cost.** **⚠ Timing that reads exactly 0.0 ms is an early return.** **⚠ In a foreign log, the loudest error is usually downstream.**
**Patching.** Re-aim the shared parameter. Find the ONE method everything funnels through - and when there is none, **wrap the DATA instead of the reader** (§32's door scope: patch the Parameterize that assigns the lists, not the Execute that reads them). Patch the PRODUCER, not the store. Own the widget. **Never put a foreign type in a patch signature**; **and when the offending parameter is a PRIVATE NESTED STRUCT, just omit it - Harmony binds by name.** **Prefix state is released in a Finalizer.** **Prefer "detect, then redo" over "always redo".** **⚠ Harmony binds postfix parameters BY NAME.**
**⚠ REIMPLEMENT RATHER THAN POSTFIX WHEN THE GEOMETRY IS A CHAIN.** Job lines and the path line both build each segment from where the last ended, so individual endpoints cannot be corrected after `GenDraw` has issued them.
**Engine facts.** `SnowGrid.CanHaveSnow` rejects on `holdSnowOrSand=false` OR a Full-fillage edifice. A `TerrainHard` shader IGNORES vertex alpha; set `renderQueue` AFTER shader assignment. **Draw order between terrain materials is render QUEUE.** A `dontRender` terrain emits only a ShadowMask. `Banded` is FALSE during map generation. FinalizeInit runs on a worker thread. **Gensteps run with live-map bookkeeping DEFERRED (~40x cheaper).** Harmony always runs FINALIZERS. **`FogGrid` is a `NativeBitArray` in 1.6.** **Vanilla rock links with `MapEdge`.** **`Graphic_Multi.Init` falls back to `_east` with `westFlipped`.**
**⚠ RENDERER FACTS THAT BIT TWICE.** Past `ZoomRootSize` 18 a humanlike renders from a **cached atlas blit** that ignores `PawnDrawParms.matrix` outright, so any matrix effect silently evaporates at exactly the zoom players use - fix is `disableCache`. **`PawnRenderer.GetDrawParms` is reached from `ParallelPreDraw`, i.e. potentially on Unity job WORKER THREADS** - gate dictionary probes behind a plain int count. **`PawnDrawParms.pawn` gives you the pawn inside the postfix.**
**⚠ WALL-MOUNTED DRAW LAYER IS `Item`, NOT `BuildingOnTop`.**
**⚠ SOUTH-FACING WALL MOUNTS NEED ZERO DRAW OFFSET WHILE N/E/W NEED 0.9.**
**⚠⚠ RIMWORLD HAS TWO UNRELATED "WALL-MOUNTED" MECHANISMS AND THEY PLACE IN DIFFERENT CELLS.**
  - `isAttachment` + `Placeworker_AttachedToWall`: occupies the OPEN cell BESIDE a wall; **the wall must declare `supportsWallAttachments` - ORDINARY COLONY WALLS DO NOT**.
  - `canPlaceOverWall` + `PlaceWorker_OnWall`: occupies the WALL'S OWN cell. **Vanilla `Vent`, VTE's wall vent/cooler all use this.** **`isEdifice=false` + `clearBuildingArea=false` both load-bearing.**
**⚠ POWER FACTS.** `ContiguousPowerBuildings` is PRIVATE; flood over `GenAdj.CellsAdjacentCardinal`. **`ConnectMaxDist = 6`** with NO line-of-sight check. **`Building.TransmitsPowerNow` is VIRTUAL and the base IGNORES flicking.** **⚠ A `private const` IS INLINED AND CANNOT BE READ BY REFLECTION.**
**⚠ PATHFINDER FACTS (§32).** `PathGridJob` is deduped through `gridJobLookup` keyed on `MapGridRequest` and **cleared every `PathFinderTick`** - once per distinct VARIANT per tick, **and `Area`/`AvoidGrid` are part of that key, so every distinct allowed area in use costs one extra full-map pass per tick.** `PathFinderJob.Execute` opens with `calcGrid.Clear()` over a 20-byte `CalcNode` per cell. `PathFinderTick` opens with `ForceCompleteScheduledJobs()`, so **no path job straddles a tick boundary** - what makes per-tick list reuse race-free. `FindPathNow` is SYNCHRONOUS and ~10 vanilla JobGivers use it. `hCost = octile * 13 * heuristicStrength`, `DefaultMoveTicksCardinal` is 13, so 1.0 is admissible; vanilla ships 1.75 for animals. **`PawnPath` is POOLED - copy nodes out and dispose, never hold one across frames.**
**⚠ COLLECTION FACT THAT COST A SESSION.** **`HashSet<T>` implements `ICollection<T>` but NOT the non-generic `System.Collections.ICollection`.** An `is ICollection` guard against a foreign `HashSet` returns false EVERY time.
**⚠ TEXTURE FACTS.** **Core textures are PACKED.** **TWO art families**: Dubwise is a thick near-black outline; Vanilla/VE is almost no outline. **Describe the SPRITE, not the object.**

---

**15d.** Vanilla's no-build edge REMOVED. **15e.** Drop pods fall through the levels.
**16.** Melt per band rewrites the private `outdoorMeltAmount` on EVERY call; **ReGrowth transpiles the same method and composes.**
**17. ⚠ The blank-tab bug:** a SELF-SUSTAINING LATCH without a floor. **⚠ Draw the diagnostic OUTSIDE the thing being diagnosed.**
**18a.** Prefix state released in a Postfix - three instances, all now `Finalizer`. **18b.** The mirror: same symptom, different cause. **18e. CLOSED.**
**19.** The 910-mod failure was **not us** - a NEGATIVE `startingPawnCount`.

## 20b. SHIPPED
1-4. VEE LoneIsland / VEE Crater / river width clamp / GL roof scope - UNVERIFIED.
5. **`ABPowerBandScope`** (§30a) - two postfixes on `PowerConnectionMaker`. UNVERIFIED.

# 32. PATHING COST — `ABPathBandScope.cs`, THREE PATCHES

## 32a. ⚠ THE PREMISE THIS PROJECT CARRIED FOR MONTHS WAS HALF WRONG
- **`PathGridJob` is NOT per request.** Deduped through `gridJobLookup`, cleared every `PathFinderTick`: **once per distinct variant per tick**, Burst and parallel. **Each distinct allowed AREA in use is one extra full-map pass per tick.**
- **What IS per request and map-sized** is `calcGrid.Clear()` in `PathFinderJob.Execute` - **2.9 MB of memset per request at 4x190**, plus 438 KB from `PathGridDoorsBlockedJob`.

**The budget stands.** Only the identity of the cost was wrong.

## 32b. ⚠ AIR CELLS ARE ALREADY FREE — DO NOT "OPTIMISE" THE GUTTER
`AB_OpenAir` is `Impassable`: `PathGridJob` writes 10000 and **skips `CostForCell`**; `PathFinderJob` drops it at `if (num5 >= 10000) continue`; `CalculatedCostAt` returns on line one. The gutter is 1.6% of cells at every tier. **This question has been asked once and answered.**

## 32c. ⚠ THE TWO BIG COSTS ARE UNPATCHABLE
Both jobs are `[BurstCompile]`. **The corollary made patch 2 possible:** a job holding managed references can never be Burst, so `PathGridDoorsBlockedJob` is the one map-sized piece that can be touched.

## 32d. THE THREE PATCHES
1. **Cross-band rejection** - `FindPathNow` prefix (**one patch covers both overloads**; the `Pawn` one delegates) + `PushRequest` prefix. Not a behaviour change: the request already failed, ~50-100x more expensively. **⚠ EVERY EARLY RETURN IS "PERMIT", NEVER "REJECT"** - not banded (**including all of map generation, which is what keeps `GenStep_Roads` working**), invalid endpoint, or **either endpoint in the gutter**.
2. **Door / pawn / provider band scope** - postfix on private `ParameterizeDoorBlockedJob`. **⚠ PATCH THE PARAMETERIZE, NOT THE EXECUTE.** **⚠ THE `ref PathUniqueState` PARAMETER IS PRIVATE AND NESTED - omit it; Harmony binds by name.** **⚠ RACE-FREE BECAUSE `PathFinderTick` OPENS WITH `ForceCompleteScheduledJobs()`** - if a future RimWorld lets a job straddle a tick, **double-buffer**.
3. **Heuristic slider** (`pathHeuristic`, Performance tab, 1.00-2.50, default off). **A vanilla trade, not a new one.** Gated on `ABBands.Banded`.

# 33. CROSS-LEVEL DRAFTED MOVEMENT — `ABTransitVisuals.cs`, `ABStairAnim.cs`, BUILT, UNVERIFIED

## 33a. THE PATH LINE — ONE SYMPTOM, TWO DEFECTS, OPPOSITE FIXES
"The line stops at the stairs" was:
1. **Before the hop it does not exist.** `TrySegment` rewrites the destination to the near anchor *before* the pather builds a path, so `curPath` correctly ends at the stairwell and the remainder lives only in the transit record.
2. **After the hop it exists a full Slot off screen.** `PawnPath.DrawPath` draws nodes at true world coordinates while `ABBelowDynamicDraw` draws the pawn at `DrawPos.z + drop`.

**Fix.** `Patch_PawnPath_ABLiftPathLine` reimplements `DrawPath` lifted into the VIEW band (reimplemented, not postfixed - **the geometry is a chain**), and `ABTransitVisuals.DrawRemainingRoute` appends the far side.
**⚠ THE FAR SIDE IS A REAL PATH, NOT A STRAIGHT LINE.** `FindPathNow` per same-band leg, walking the hop chain via `TryGetTransit`. **⚠ IT RUNS FROM A DRAW CALLBACK, so it is lazy (selected pawns only), cached on the transit's NEAR ANCHOR, and refreshed every 150 ticks.** Keying on the anchor makes invalidation automatic - a re-issued order picks a new anchor. **⚠ `PawnPath` IS POOLED: nodes are copied out and the path disposed immediately.**
**⚠ THE ANCHOR-TO-ANCHOR SEGMENT COLLAPSES TO A POINT once both ends are lifted, which is correct** - the two ends are a Slot apart in world space and zero cells apart in travel. Drawing them unlifted would put a line through the gutter.
**⚠ EVERY SAME-BAND LEG IS DELIBERATE, WHICH MAKES §32's GUARD A SAFETY NET** - a malformed hop chain gets an O(1) rejection instead of draining a band inside a draw call.

## 33b. FORCE-MOVE UP DID NOTHING — AND IT WAS DELIBERATE CODE
`TryTranslateForOrder` rewrote any click whose band differed from the commanded pawns' band ONTO the pawns' band. Every upward order became a same-band shuffle. The see-through fallback beneath it only ever descends (`clickPos.z - drop`), so **DOWN worked only because cursor and pawn shared a band**. Same downward-only asymmetry as §1 / §13 item 2.

**Fix: the VIEW BAND is the discriminator.** Clicking a cell on the level you are looking at means that level; the order passes through untranslated for the wormhole router. Gated on the existing `AnyCanReach`, so with no stairs built the old behaviour is kept rather than issuing orders that quietly fail. **Applies to ALL orders, by the user's call.**
**⚠ `Patch_RCellFinder_ABOrderedGotoBand` WAS ALREADY CORRECT** - it checks `CanReach` first and leaves genuine cross-level orders to the router. Only the click interception needed changing. **Do not "fix" it too.**
**⚠ THE ORIGINAL TRANSLATION IS NOT A BUG AND MUST SURVIVE.** It is what fixed "three drafted pawns, only one moves".

## 33c. THE STAIR ANIMATION — SHIMMY AND SHRINK
Pawn shrinks to 35% with a decaying sideways shimmy as it enters, pops back out on the far side over 26 ticks.

**⚠ THE TELEPORT IS NOT DELAYED AND MUST NEVER BE.** Holding the pawn to animate would put a timed window inside the subsystem that has already produced three "stuck at the stairs" bugs, and a pawn frozen mid-animation is indistinguishable from a jammed one. **This is purely a renderer effect; nothing here can strand anyone.**
That constraint dictates the two halves being driven differently: **shrink is a pure function of DISTANCE to the near anchor** (no state, no cleanup, self-cancelling if the pawn walks away), **pop-out is TICKS SINCE THE HOP** (one int per pawn, expires itself).
**⚠ IT COMPOSES WITH THE DEPTH CUE IN THE ONE EXISTING POSTFIX** (§8b). Two patches right-multiplying the same matrix would work by accident and break on reorder.
**⚠ AND THEIR GUARDS DIFFER:** `BelowDrawScale` is armed only inside the see-below pass, so early-returning on it would mean **a pawn taking the stairs on the band you are looking at never animates** - the common case.
**⚠ THE CACHED ATLAS BLIT EATS THIS TOO.** Past `ZoomRootSize` 18 the matrix is ignored, so `disableCache` now covers the stair case as well as the depth case.
**⚠ SAME-BAND TEST, NOT JUST DISTANCE.** A pawn standing directly above its own stairwell is close in x and a whole Slot apart in z.
**⚠ `GetDrawParms` REACHES WORKER THREADS via `ParallelPreDraw`** - both dictionary probes are gated behind plain int counts so the common case never walks a bucket chain off-thread.

## 33d. HOW TO VERIFY
Draft a pawn on a LOWER band, switch the view UP, right-click solid ground: it should walk to the stairs and come up. Watch the line past the stairs, and watch the pawn shrink into and pop out of the stairwell. Then repeat downward, and repeat with the view on the pawn's own band. `AB2: why is this pawn stuck` if anyone jams.
